summary_points: Proyecto Solana Generating Station ubicado en Arizona
Parcela legal de 7,514,527 square feet

Drawing sections A-A' and B-B'
Notice of Alternate Billing Cycle in contract terms
First issue date: 01/30/18
Revisions made on various dates by different individuals
El documento es propiedad de Abener Engineering and Construction Services, LLC.
Se permite facturación en ciclos alternativos a los de 30 días.
Los detalles del desarrollo de la rebar incluyen tipos D1, D2 y D3 para diferentes fuerzas del concreto.
Las barras pueden tener diámetros de 0.38, 0.50, 0.63, 0.75, 0.88, 1.00, 1.13, 1.27 y 1.41 pulgadas.
La longitud mínima de inmersión del acero en concreto varía según el tipo de barra.
Bundled bars of more than 2 bars (including splice bar) in the same plane are not permitted.
Use bar diameter derived from equivalent total area to determine applicable splice type for bundled bars.
Do not splice more than one bar in a bundle.
Bar location is specified for top and other bars.
Development types include typical, seismic, D1, D2, and D3.
Reinforcing splice lengths are adjusted based on concrete grade and weight.
Special inspection required for adhesive anchors.
Drill & epoxy to be used only where indicated on drawings.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles.
Footings must not be undermined by pipe trenches.
Reinforcement requirements vary based on slab thickness and joint spacing.
Slab on grade pour in strips with specific jointing requirements.
Wall reinforcement includes minimum requirements and special cases.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
General Civil and Structural Notes referenced as 4521-PLN-ANC-00-50-S001.
Anchor Rod Assemblies and Details referenced as 4521-PLN-ANC-00-50-C001.
Foundation bearing capacity is 3,000PSF.
Geotechnical Engineer to inspect excavations for concrete placement.
Backfilling and compaction below foundation must follow geotechnical report recommendations.
Anchor bolts supplied by supplier. More info in drawing 4521-PLN-LOI-039-062-0003-GAR.
Exchanger equipment details in drawing 4521-LOI-039-062-0001-GAR.
